en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika), the Triplet of Having the Path as Object (Maggārammaṇattika).

Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor has the Path as its object, a wholesome state that has the Path as its object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor has the Path as its root, a wholesome state that has the Path as its root arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Conditioned by an unwholesome state dominated by the Path, a wholesome state dominated by the Path arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] under root; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.
